item.title: NYC congestion pricing policy linked to cleaner air in lower Manhattan
item.description: One year after New York City launched its congestion pricing policy, fine particulate pollution inside Manhattan's congestion relief zone was 13% lower, according to a new analysis that accounted for regional pollution trends, weather and normal year-to-year variability. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Violencia escolar: ¿se está replicando en México el patrón de los tiroteos en EE. UU.?
item.description: Una serie de ataques recientes en centros educativos de México ha encendido las alarmas a nivel nacional, obligando a cuestionar si el país está replicando el fenómeno de los tiroteos escolares de Estados Unidos. La respuesta de los especialistas revela un escenario complejo donde convergen la proliferación de armas de fuego ilegales, la normalización comunitaria de la violencia y un ecosistema digital que capitaliza la vulnerabilidad adolescente mediante discursos misóginos y de odio. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Sharks’ Long-Range Hearing: Study finds 74m sound detection; sharks turn away
item.description: A team of researchers from Florida Atlantic University discovered that wild blacktip sharks possess the ability to detect low-frequency sounds from considerable distances. This groundbreaking study sheds light on how these sharks navigate their aquatic environments, as they exhibited keen directional hearing by making sharp turns in response to sound sources. item.title: White House promotes 'Trump TV' with an AI-altered photo
item.description: The White House has promoted “Trump TV” using an AI-altered photo of passengers apparently watching the president’s new streaming channel. But the image was originally posted online in February 2023, showing passengers watching the NFL Super Bowl, with one watching the film “Hitch”. The original photo was modified using AI to make it appear the passengers were watching Trump TV. The post did not disclose that the image had been altered. Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.
